subject: Solid Waste Contract Re-evaluation
overview: The Medford Solid Waste Task Force held an introductory meeting to launch a public survey and seek community feedback on solid waste, recycling, and composting services ahead of re-evaluating the city's waste disposal contract.

items.title: Welcome and Task Force Introductions
items.summary: Co-Chair Alicia Hunt opened the meeting and introduced task force members and staffing support.

items.title: Solid Waste Contract and Public Survey Presentation
items.summary: Alicia Hunt outlined the city's plan to re-evaluate waste disposal services and detailed outreach for resident and business surveys open through October 1.

items.title: Public Comment and Q&A
items.summary: Task force members and staff addressed public comments regarding trash pickup restrictions, costs for bulky and extra items, city drop-off options, and plastic film recycling constraints.
